scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi there! I recently applied for a VA home purchase loan and I'm just checking in on the status of my application. Could you tell me if it has been approved, denied, or is still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your loan application has been approved and originated. Is there anything else you'd like to know about your loan?

dialogue.user: That's great to hear! Could you tell me what the interest rate is and the total costs associated with the loan? Also, is there any indication of high-cost or negative amortization flags on my loan?
dialogue.agent: The interest rate on your loan is 7.250%. The total loan costs are $8,341.61. Your loan is not classified as a high-cost mortgage and does not have any negative amortization features.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. I appreciate the clarity. Could you also confirm if my loan has been transferred or sold to another institution? Additionally, what type of loan product was I approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your loan was sold to Ginnie Mae. You were approved for a VA:First Lien loan product.

dialogue.user: Got it. One last thing, what is my debt-to-income ratio and how does it affect my application?
dialogue.agent: Your debt-to-income ratio is 37%. This ratio is the percentage of your monthly income that goes toward paying your debts. It is used to assess your ability to manage monthly loan payments.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the detailed information. I feel well-informed about my loan status and terms. <Satisfied> The agent was clear, courteous, and provided all the necessary details I needed to understand my loan.
